LESSON: CONSERVING WATER: ● SUNKEN SEEDBED ● SHALLOW PITS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.2: Conserving Water: ● Sunken seedbed ● Shallow pits
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Conserving Water: ● Sunken seedbed ● Shallow pits, part of Conservation of Resources in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we prepare a seedbed to conserve moisture?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign types of seedbeds used in conserving soil moisture.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Conserving Water: ● Sunken seedbed ● Shallow pits in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Conserving Water: ● Sunken seedbed ● Shallow pits together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Social justice: fairness and justice as learners share tasks and responsibilities in preparation of seedbeds.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Conservation of resources as learners conserve water through preparation of water conserving seedbeds.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate conservation of soil moisture to farming activities learnt in social studies.

Suggested learning resources

• Captioned video clips

• Photographs

• Resource person

• Farming equipment such as pangas, jembes among others
